title: incident-bot: add on-call runbook quick-links and SLO->runbook matcher
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: operators frequently need fast access to runbooks from incident Slack threads and pager alerts. The incident-bot previously linked runbooks by exact tag or manual mapping which was brittle during SLO rotations. This PR adds two complementary features: 1) quick-links in on-call summaries (short list of top-relevant runbooks with context snippets) and 2) an SLO->runbook matcher that ranks candidate runbooks by signal overlap (SLO name, metric names, alert tags) and provides a confidence score. Implementation: new internal/runbooks/linker.go contains the matching and ranking logic; internal/slo/matcher.go contains lightweight signal extraction from SLO configs and alert payloads; cmd/incident-bot now renders runbook quick-links in the oncall summary block and attaches runbook anchors to automated diagnostics messages. Added a small runbook metadata index (web/fixtures/runbook_index.json) and a migration script to build it from the existing runbook corpus. Tests: unit tests cover matcher scoring heuristics and end-to-end integration test simulates an alert and asserts the top-3 runbooks include the primary runbook. Docs: docs/oncall-runbooks.md documents how runbooks should be tagged and how the confidence score is computed. Backwards compatibility: the default ranking is conservative and will not replace existing explicit runbook links; operators can opt-in to higher-recall matching via a feature flag. Rollout plan: feature behind a runtime flag, enable for 10% of incidents for 24h, evaluate feedback and metrics (click-through and oncall time-to-resolve). Related: ENG-1024 (oncall tooling improvements), ENG-1108 (runbook cataloging).

review_comments: Marco Chen: Nice work — the ranking heuristics look reasonable. Two asks: (1) can we expose the raw matched signals in the diagnostics message (for debugging), and (2) add a small benchmark for matcher latency in common worst-case payloads?
Aisha Patel: Thanks — added matched signals to diagnostics output and added a microbenchmark; results are ~0.8ms median on CI CPU, <4ms 99th. See linker_test.go changes.

Ravi Singh: Security question — runbook_index.json contains internal URLs. Make sure links are rendered only to users in the oncall channel and not leaked to external integrations. Also please add an audit log entry when a runbook link is clicked.
Aisha Patel: Added channel-scoped rendering and a click audit event emitted to the same audit pipeline used by the alerting UI. Tests added.
Lina Gómez: Approve after address Marco comments and add small note about feature-flag rollout in the docs.
Marco Chen: Approve after nits addressed.
release_notes: Adds runbook quick-links and an SLO->runbook matcher to incident-bot. Quick-links surface top relevant runbooks in oncall summaries and diagnostics. Feature is behind a runtime flag and off by default.
